## R packages

- **[`spexvb`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=spexvb)** (CRAN). Parameter expanded
  variational Bayes for high-dimensional linear regression with spike-and-slab priors.
  Written in R and C++ (Rcpp/RcppArmadillo). Source on
  [GitHub](https://github.com/peterolejua/spexvb).
- **[`spxlvb`](https://github.com/peterolejua/spxlvb)** (GitHub). Parameter exploded
  variational Bayes for sparse high-dimensional linear regression.
- **[`lmmprobe`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lmmprobe)** (CRAN, co-author). Sparse
  high-dimensional linear mixed models with a partitioned empirical Bayes ECM algorithm. I
  optimized the package by rewriting its core routines in C++ with OpenMP.

## Python

- **[`py-spexvb`](https://github.com/peterolejua/py-spexvb)** (under development). Python port
  of `spexvb`.

## Contributions

**[GGIR](https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR)** is the R package for processing raw accelerometer
data. Two of my pull requests were merged in July 2026:

- [#1522](https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/pull/1522): fixed an NA/NaN error in `g.impute()`
  (non-wear imputation) when a study dates file is used, and the date handling in
  `check_log()`.
- [#1523](https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/pull/1523): fixed activity-log (`qwindow`) segments
  that were assigned one day early.
